verdict.rationale: Docs show Grok can ingest images and connect to Google Drive/Gmail to search and read files, and boasts a 500k context window for knowledge work, implying some document handling, but there is no explicit documentation of native PDF or spreadsheet upload/parsing in the core chat UI, nor any accuracy benchmarks or hands-on validation of document analysis. Missing for 10: explicit PDF/spreadsheet upload feature docs, accuracy testing/validation, independent user reports confirming reliable document analysis.
